added.member: UI: CSS background-color, background-position-x and -y, background-clip: border-area, and light-dark() images
added.summary: background-color sets an element's colour alone; background-position-x and background-position-y set one axis of each layer's position (an edge keyword with its offset, a length or a percentage), background-position resetting both; background-clip: border-area paints a layer only under the border (the border box less the padding box); a colour with a box in the background shorthand (#123 padding-box) is clipped by it; and light-dark(<image>, <image>) picks a background, mask or border image by the element's colour scheme.

fixed.member: UI: background-clip on a background colour alone
fixed.summary: A background colour with no image now takes background-clip (padding-box, content-box); it was drawn over the whole border box.
